parole.testo: Borrowed from Northwestern Iranian, from Proto-Iranian [Term?].

Borrowed from a Northwestern Iranian cognate of Manichaean Middle Persian 𐫤𐫗𐫉- (tnz- /⁠tanz-⁠/, “to strain, press”), from Proto-Iranian *tanč- (“to twist (together), become narrow, dense, constrict”), from Proto-Indo-European *tenk- (“to compact”). Akin to Ossetian тындзын (tynʒyn), Old Armenian տան

Probably a loanword from Northwestern Iranian. Compare Gazi مکامن (mekāmun, “to suck”). Ultimately from Proto-Iranian *maič- (“to suck”), Northern Luri مژنیێ (mejnyı, “to suck”), which has no clear Indo-European etymology.
